sources.title: Qwen3-Next release announcement
sources.evidence: Parent read indexed complete primary announcement naming both Instruct and Thinking weight releases. Page displays September10; API release table dates both September11. Exact day remains qualified rather than choosing one event.

patch.description: Non-thinking Qwen3-Next text model with hybrid attention and sparse MoE, supporting multilingual chat and tool use.
patch.notes: 80B total and 3B activated are nominal developer-reported counts. Architecture combines Gated DeltaNet and Gated Attention with MoE. Native context is 262144 tokens. Release month is September 2025; indexed announcement and API availability dates differ by one day.

summary: Confirmed 80B total, 3B activated, MoE, native context, text modalities, non-thinking behavior and tool support. Added license, exact release day and a variant-specific description. All 14 fields verified.
